name: Litecoin
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: Litecoin posted on X, stating that their X account was briefly compromised and some unauthorized content was published. These posts were deleted within seconds. They are still investigating the incident but have immediately found a delegated account that was compromised and removed it.
